asked.item: Does OAuth sign-in work in Gemini CLI
Does Gemini CLI only accept the blotato-api-key header
Is Gemini CLI an officially supported client

verdict.reason: The help pages never name Gemini CLI, so no sentence states whether OAuth or the blotato-api-key header works there or whether it is supported; the generic "another remote-MCP client" guidance cannot be applied because the pages say not to infer support from general MCP compatibility or apply one client's setup to another.
